verdict.rationale: DBOS is an open-source library whose only infrastructure is a Postgres database you supply. Workflow checkpoints and state are written to that database, so you decide where the data lives. Conductor and the DBOS Console can also be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, keeping management data under your control too. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of region or data-residency selection for the managed DBOS Cloud/Conductor offerings, any residency or compliance statements, and independent corroboration of residency control.
